title: BTN facing a CO raise
keyIdea: The CO opens wide, and you have the best position at the table. Play many hands: 3-bet a strong and bluffy range, call with lots of playable hands.

actions.call: 99-22, ATs-A6s, KJs-K9s, QJs-QTs, J9s+, T9s, 98s, 87s, 76s, AJo-ATo, KQo-KJo

notes.A5s: A classic bluff raise: the ace blocks AA/AK, and it can still make a straight or the nut flush.
